dataset.archive_integrity: Partial streaming acquisition; no whole-archive SHA-256 claim

partition_basis.method: Executed the original AST definition with its original hash constant

dataset.selection: First validation members encountered in official archive; distinct speaker IDs; no accuracy-based selection

intermediate_reference_method: Same-object official-layer replay without hooks; state propagation calls each full original block; replay final logits exactly equal original unhook complete model

runtime.compatibility_note: Upstream rc1 wheel unavailable on checked current indices; closest stable 2.4.0 used without source/checkpoint changes. No rc1 bit-equality claim.

samples.definition: Official silence behavior: foreground_volume=0, no background; all-zero raw audio

scope: Float32 software baseline; subset predictions only; no full dataset accuracy, quantization or RTL claims
